purpose: Larger controlled finance Nexus evaluation after the all-five v3 preliminary pilot.

nexus_variant.name: finance_deterministic_scout_architect
nexus_variant.description: Deterministic evidence retrieval plus one LLM adjudicator call.

adapter_policy.financebench: Use FinanceBench evidence strings plus metadata.
adapter_policy.finder: Use evidence-packet environment with narrative adjudication.
adapter_policy.finqa: Use evidence-packet environment with numeric answer normalization.
adapter_policy.tatqa: Flatten table/text evidence into evidence packets.
adapter_policy.convfinqa: Include prior conversation context and chunk long filing contexts into overlapping searchable chunks.

claim_rule: Claim supported only when Nexus has higher paired accuracy and lower mean LLM calls than ReAct on the same valid example count.
known_caveats: Cost is call-count cost, not token or dollar cost.
Accuracy uses a finance-aware heuristic scorer, not official dataset-native evaluation.
The worktree is not clean; interpret this protocol as a frozen research lane configuration, not a repository release tag.
